title: Closing Service Charges on a Corrected Closing Disclosure for a Mortgage Loan File
content:
The latest Closing Disclosure is the one with the highest disclosure sequence on the file. The closing service line of a corrected Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File is read from the file's closing in scheduled status — the Closing and Funding engagement now scheduled on the file: its closing method, the date it was opened, and the day of the week of its scheduled closing date. The fees are those of that closing method in the Closing and Funding method schedule — the closing method fee (the fee for the closing method itself) and the after-hours signing fee.

**Rule.** Where that closing was opened on a date later than the issue date of the latest Closing Disclosure, is a Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing and its scheduled closing date falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the closing method's closing method fee and its after-hours signing fee are added; where it was opened on a date later than the issue date of the latest Closing Disclosure and is a Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing signing on a weekday, or a Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing signing on any day, only the closing method's closing method fee is added; where it was opened on or before the issue date of the latest Closing Disclosure, or is of any other method, or the file has no closing in scheduled status, or the file carries no Closing Disclosure, or a Mobile Notary Closing has no scheduled closing date, nothing is added for the closing service.

## Decision table

| Closing in scheduled status | Opened on a date later than the latest Closing Disclosure's issue date | Signing day | Line |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | yes | Saturday or Sunday | closing method fee plus after-hours signing fee |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | yes | Monday to Friday | closing method fee |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | yes | any day | closing method fee |
| any method | no — opened on or before that issue date | any | nothing |
| any other method | either | any | nothing |
| no closing in scheduled status | — | — | nothing |
| any | — (the file carries no Closing Disclosure) | — | nothing |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | yes | no scheduled closing date | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical, latest Closing Disclosure issued on 2 June)

- A Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing opened on 5 June and scheduled to sign on a Saturday: its closing method fee and after-hours signing fee are both added.
- A Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing opened on 5 June and scheduled to sign on a Sunday: its closing method fee only.
- The same Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing opened on 2 June, the issue date itself: nothing is added.
